```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,

  fig.path = "man/figures/README-"

  base.url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/doccstat/fastcpd/r/"
)
options(cli.hyperlink = FALSE, eval = TRUE)

comparison_violin <- function(data, order, label) {
  data$algorithm <- factor(data$algorithm, levels = rev(order))
  ggplot2::ggplot(data, ggplot2::aes(x = algorithm, y = elapsed_s)) +
    ggplot2::geom_violin(trim = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = label) +
    ggplot2::coord_flip() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.border = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "grey20"),
      panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_line(colour = "grey98"),
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_line(colour = "grey98"),
      strip.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "grey85", colour = "grey20")
    )
}

run_isolated <- function(expr) {
  callr::r(function(e, n) {
    set.seed(1)
    mean_data <- c(rnorm(n / 2, 0, 1), rnorm(n / 2, 50, 1))
    system.time(eval(e))
  }, args = list(e = substitute(expr), n = n))
}
```

## Documentation: [x2r.io](https://x2r.io/fastcpd/reference/)

Python and standalone C++ sources are published in
the `py` and `cpp` branches of [`fastcpd`](https://github.com/doccstat/fastcpd).

<details>
<summary>Installation: R, Python, and C++</summary>

R package:

```r
install.packages("fastcpd")
```

Python package:

```shell
python -m pip install fastcpd
```

C++ library (requires Armadillo and Abseil 20260526 or newer):

```shell
git clone --branch cpp https://github.com/doccstat/fastcpd.git fastcpd-cpp
cmake -S fastcpd-cpp -B fastcpd-cpp/build -DFASTCPD_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF
cmake --build fastcpd-cpp/build --parallel
cmake --install fastcpd-cpp/build --prefix fastcpd-install
```

</details>

## Comparison

### R

```{r time-comparison-single}
set.seed(1)
n <- 10^7
mean_data <- c(rnorm(n / 2, 0, 1), rnorm(n / 2, 50, 1))
print(run_isolated(fastcpd::detect_mean(mean_data, cp_only = TRUE, variance_estimation = 1)))
print(run_isolated(mosum::mosum(c(mean_data), G = 40)))
print(run_isolated(changepoint::cpt.mean(mean_data, method = "PELT")))
print(run_isolated(fpop::Fpop(mean_data, 2 * log(n))))
```
```{r time-comparison-fastbench, eval = requireNamespace("callr", quietly = TRUE), echo = FALSE}
benchmark <- function(..., times = 100L) {
  calls <- as.list(match.call(expand.dots = FALSE)$`...`)
  nms <- names(calls); envir <- parent.frame()
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(calls), function(i)
    data.frame(expr = factor(nms[i], levels = nms),
               elapsed_s = replicate(times, system.time(eval(calls[[i]], envir))["elapsed"]))))
}
bm <- benchmark(
  baseline = callr::r(function(n) {
    set.seed(1)
    c(rnorm(n / 2, 0, 1), rnorm(n / 2, 50, 1))
  }, args = list(n = n)),
  fastcpd = callr::r(function(n) {
    set.seed(1)
    mean_data <- c(rnorm(n / 2, 0, 1), rnorm(n / 2, 50, 1))
    fastcpd::detect_mean(mean_data, cp_only = TRUE, variance_estimation = 1)
  }, args = list(n = n)),
  mosum = callr::r(function(n) {
    set.seed(1)
    mean_data <- c(rnorm(n / 2, 0, 1), rnorm(n / 2, 50, 1))
    mosum::mosum(c(mean_data), G = 40)
  }, args = list(n = n)),
  changepoint = callr::r(function(n) {
    set.seed(1)
    mean_data <- c(rnorm(n / 2, 0, 1), rnorm(n / 2, 50, 1))
    changepoint::cpt.mean(mean_data, method = "PELT")
  }, args = list(n = n)),
  fpop = callr::r(function(n) {
    set.seed(1)
    mean_data <- c(rnorm(n / 2, 0, 1), rnorm(n / 2, 50, 1))
    fpop::Fpop(mean_data, 2 * log(n))
  }, args = list(n = n)),
  times = 10L
)
baseline_overhead <- median(bm$elapsed_s[bm$expr == "baseline"])
bm_net <- bm[bm$expr != "baseline", ]
bm_net$elapsed_s <- bm_net$elapsed_s - baseline_overhead
plot_order <- c("fastcpd", "mosum", "changepoint", "fpop")
bm_net$algorithm <- bm_net$expr
if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  print(comparison_violin(bm_net, plot_order, "Net algorithm time (s)"))
}
```

### Python

```{python time-comparison-python-single, eval=FALSE, python.reticulate=FALSE}
import time

import fastcpd
import numpy as np
import ruptures
import sdt
import sdt.changepoint
import skchange
import skchange.detectors
import skchange.interval_scorers

rng = np.random.default_rng(1)
n = int(1e4)
x = np.r_[rng.normal(0, 1, n // 2), rng.normal(50, 1, n // 2)]

start = time.perf_counter()
fastcpd.detect_mean(x, variance_estimation=1, cp_only=True)
print(f"fastcpd: {time.perf_counter() - start:.3f} s")

start = time.perf_counter()
skchange.detectors.PELT(
    cost=skchange.interval_scorers.L2Cost(), penalty=2 * np.log(n), step_size=1
).fit_predict(x.reshape(-1, 1))
print(f"skchange: {time.perf_counter() - start:.3f} s")

start = time.perf_counter()
sdt.changepoint.Pelt(cost="l2", min_size=1, jump=1).find_changepoints(
    x, penalty=2 * np.log(n)
)
print(f"sdt-python: {time.perf_counter() - start:.3f} s")

start = time.perf_counter()
ruptures.Pelt(model="l2", min_size=1, jump=1).fit(x).predict(
    pen=2 * np.log(n)
)
print(f"ruptures: {time.perf_counter() - start:.3f} s")
```

```{python time-comparison-python, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE, python.reticulate=FALSE}
import fastcpd
import numpy as np
import ruptures
import sdt
import sdt.changepoint
import skchange
import skchange.detectors
import skchange.interval_scorers

rng = np.random.default_rng(1)
n = int(1e4)
x = np.r_[rng.normal(0, 1, n // 2), rng.normal(50, 1, n // 2)]

benchmark("fastcpd", lambda: fastcpd.detect_mean(x, variance_estimation=1, cp_only=True))
benchmark("skchange", lambda: skchange.detectors.PELT(cost=skchange.interval_scorers.L2Cost(), penalty=2 * np.log(n), step_size=1).fit_predict(x.reshape(-1, 1)))
benchmark("sdt-python", lambda: sdt.changepoint.Pelt(cost="l2", min_size=1, jump=1).find_changepoints(x, penalty=2 * np.log(n)))
benchmark("ruptures", lambda: ruptures.Pelt(model="l2", min_size=1, jump=1).fit(x).predict(pen=2 * np.log(n)))
```

```{r time-comparison-python-single-run, echo=FALSE}
python_executable <- Sys.getenv("FASTCPD_README_PYTHON", unset = Sys.which("python3"))
if (!nzchar(python_executable)) stop("Set FASTCPD_README_PYTHON to a Python with fastcpd and comparison packages")
python_script <- tempfile(fileext = ".py")
writeLines(unlist(knitr::knit_code$get("time-comparison-python-single"), use.names = FALSE), python_script)
python_output <- system2(python_executable, python_script, stdout = TRUE, stderr = TRUE)
unlink(python_script)
if (!is.null(attr(python_output, "status")) && attr(python_output, "status") != 0) stop(paste(python_output, collapse = "\n"))
cat(paste(python_output, collapse = "\n"))
```

```{python time-comparison-python-helper, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE, python.reticulate=FALSE}
import time


def benchmark(name, call):
    call()  # Warm up imports and Numba compilation before timing.
    for _ in range(10):
        start = time.perf_counter()
        result = call()
        seconds = time.perf_counter() - start
        if name == "fastcpd":
            change_points = result.cp_set.tolist()
        elif name == "ruptures":
            change_points = result[:-1]
        else:
            change_points = result.tolist()
        assert change_points == [n // 2]
        print(f"{name}\t{seconds:.9f}")
```

```{r time-comparison-python-run, include=FALSE}
python_executable <- Sys.getenv(
  "FASTCPD_README_PYTHON",
  unset = Sys.which("python3")
)
if (!nzchar(python_executable)) {
  stop("Set FASTCPD_README_PYTHON to a Python with fastcpd, ruptures, skchange[numba] and sdt-python")
}
python_script <- tempfile(fileext = ".py")
python_source <- unlist(
  knitr::knit_code$get(c("time-comparison-python-helper", "time-comparison-python")),
  use.names = FALSE
)
writeLines(python_source, python_script)
python_output <- system2(
  python_executable,
  python_script,
  stdout = TRUE,
  stderr = TRUE
)
unlink(python_script)
python_status <- attr(python_output, "status")
if (!is.null(python_status) && python_status != 0) {
  stop(paste(python_output, collapse = "\n"))
}
python_benchmark <- utils::read.delim(
  text = paste(python_output, collapse = "\n"),
  header = FALSE,
  col.names = c("algorithm", "elapsed_s"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
python_benchmark$algorithm <- factor(
  python_benchmark$algorithm,
  levels = c("fastcpd", "skchange", "sdt-python", "ruptures")
)
```

```{r time-comparison-python-plot, echo=FALSE}
if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  print(comparison_violin(
    python_benchmark, levels(python_benchmark$algorithm),
    "Elapsed time (s)"
  ))
}
```

### C++

Native fastcpd and fpop on Linux ARM64, with 1,000,000 observations.
[Source and build instructions](https://github.com/doccstat/fastcpd/tree/r/tools/readme-comparison).

```{r time-comparison-cpp-run, include=FALSE}
cpp_executable <- Sys.getenv("FASTCPD_README_CPP")
if (!nzchar(cpp_executable)) {
  stop("Set FASTCPD_README_CPP to the compiled readme_comparison executable")
}
set.seed(1)
cpp_n <- 1000000L
comparison_input <- tempfile(fileext = ".txt")
writeLines(sprintf("%.17g", c(rnorm(cpp_n / 2), rnorm(cpp_n / 2, 50))), comparison_input)
cpp_output <- system2(cpp_executable, shQuote(comparison_input), stdout = TRUE, stderr = TRUE)
unlink(comparison_input)
cpp_status <- attr(cpp_output, "status")
if (!is.null(cpp_status) && cpp_status != 0) {
  stop(paste(cpp_output, collapse = "\n"))
}
cpp_benchmark <- utils::read.delim(
  text = paste(cpp_output, collapse = "\n"), header = FALSE,
  col.names = c("algorithm", "change_points", "elapsed_s")
)
cpp_benchmark$algorithm <- factor(cpp_benchmark$algorithm, levels = c("fastcpd", "fpop"))
```

```{r time-comparison-cpp-plot, echo=FALSE}
print(comparison_violin(cpp_benchmark, c("fastcpd", "fpop"), "Elapsed time (s)"))
```
